segments.he: רַבִּי מֵאִיר אוֹמֵר: בְּאֶחָד בֶּאֱלוּל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה לְמַעְשַׂר בְּהֵמָה. בֶּן עַזַּאי אוֹמֵר וְכוּ׳. תַּנְיָא, אָמַר בֶּן עַזַּאי: הוֹאִיל וְהַלָּלוּ אוֹמְרִים כָּךְ, וְהַלָּלוּ אוֹמְרִים כָּךְ — הָאֱלוּלִין מִתְעַשְּׂרִין לְעַצְמָן.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Meir says:» The beginning of «the new year for animal tithe is on the first of Elul. Ben Azzai says:» The animals born in Elul are tithed by themselves, due to the uncertainty as to whether the halakha is in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi Meir or in accordance with the opinion of Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon. The Gemara notes that «it is taught» in a baraita that «ben Azzai said: Since these» Rabbis, Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Shimon, «say this,» that the first of Tishrei is the beginning of the new year for animal tithe, «and those,» i.e., Rabbi Meir, «say that» the first of Elul is the beginning of the new year for animal tithe, «the» animals born in «Elul are tithed by themselves.»
